name: Luca Baumann
bio:
Luca's fascination with motorsport began in his childhood, captivated by the vibrant liveries of race cars. This passion led him to pursue a vocational degree in automotive painting and design. His eye for detail and understanding of aerodynamic principles quickly set him apart. Luca honed his skills at a local body shop, specializing in custom paint jobs and restorations, before joining Reiza Studios Factory.

At Reiza, Luca is responsible for ensuring the team's cars not only look stunning but also benefit from optimal paint application for aerodynamic efficiency. He is meticulous in his work, constantly experimenting with new paints and techniques to improve performance. His calm demeanor under pressure makes him a valuable asset during tight deadlines, and his innovative ideas have already led to improvements in the team's livery design process. He's particularly proud of developing a new matte finish that reduces drag without sacrificing visual appeal.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Luca is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always wears nitrile gloves, even when not directly working with paint.
Carries a small notebook filled with paint swatches and design ideas.
